correctness.rationale: Every face of the triple polygon join has at most six vertices, so D^3 is a graph. Exact occupancy pairing gives the four-factor disjoint-union isomorphism. Standard parity of simultaneous walks yields all component counts; rotation symmetries and E−V+1 yield each exact integral circle rank. Eight independent exhaustive facet-based graph constructions agree.

value.rationale: The family of all joins of three polygon boundaries is a canonical class of combinatorial 5-spheres. The theorem entirely resolves their three-tuple homotopy and parity phase behavior and gives a natural sharp connectivity example: even a 5-sphere can have 4 to 10 nontrivial triple-tuple components. The complete componentwise ranks are not supplied by the general construction theorem.
